jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day Join our innovative team where you will lead the charge in advanced materials research and development! Imagine developing and applying cutting-edge AI models for material discovery and property prediction, while also conceptualizing and executing research projects for novel materials and chemical processes. You will conduct complex experiments using advanced analytical techniques to characterize material properties and performance, and integrate materials models and simulations to accelerate design and qualification. Get ready to create and test prototypes of new material applications, validating their performance against technical specifications and project targets!How You’ll Make an Impact * Develop and apply AI-driven models to accelerate material discovery, predict material properties, and optimize processes* Lead research and development projects focused on innovative materials, chemical processes, and advanced material solutions* Design and conduct experiments using advanced analytical methods to characterize, validate, and improve material performance* Build and integrate materials simulations, predictive models, and digital twins to support faster product development and qualification* Validate AI-generated material candidates through laboratory, pilot-scale testing, and prototype development against technical requirements* Provide technical leadership by defining development roadmaps, collaborating with cross-functional teams, communicating results to stakeholders, and tracking emerging industry innovationsWhat You Bring* Master's degree or PhD in Materials Science or a closely related field * Several years of professional experience in an industrial research and development environment, focused on materials development and discovery * Demonstrated experience leading complex technical projects from concept through to implementation * Practical experience with AI‑based materials discovery platforms or custom ML pipelines * Exposure to high‑throughput experimentation, automation, or autonomous labs * Strong communication skills to translate complex technical insights into actionable outcomes. Fluent English required, German a plus  About the TeamIn our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. jobs.description: About usAirbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.Job descriptionAirbus Defence and Space is looking for aNavigation and Surveillance Systems Commodity Manager (d/f/m)We are a transnational organization with substantial footprints in all four founding countries and beyond. Our organization has significant impact in the P&L of the full spectrum of Airbus Defence and Space Air Power programmes; and in addition we have an external reach with more than 10,000 active suppliers… Come join us in Procurement to learn more and be a significant part of our business!Procurement, Supply Chain and Logistics offers opportunities to expand on experiences and grow within a dynamic organization. Whether it be within project supply or commodity management, contracts expertise, supply chain operations or logistics management, the procurement team uses collective intelligence and maximizes synergies to continuously improve and deliver results.Alongside the ongoing operational business that brings our people up close and personal with the DS products and suppliers, we are also expanding on initiatives to become a more digital and impactful organization. It's an exciting time to be part of Procurement!You will join the Navigation and Surveillance Systems Commodity for all Airbus Defence AirPower platforms including legacy programs, but also UAS, Combat and FCAS programs or future programs. This will give you a unique wide vision of the AirPower current and future business.You will work developing structural relationships with well established worldwide suppliers, while managing complex work packages and suppliers with an important annual spend within our avionics scope.Your location:Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.Our Benefits for You:- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.One of the main responsibilities is to develop, and execute, a strategy for your sub-commodities, which will include to get a deep understanding of the market, supply base, technological drivers, tendering, negotiations and long-term contract establishment with selected suppliers. As well supplier analysis (supplier evaluation, supplier financial analysis, etc), risk assessment and management, and make or buy business case, etc.You will develop a solid working knowledge of certain commodity trends including: cost drivers, global pricing, market and industry trends and material lead times to maintain availability of cost-effective supplies of materials, equipment and services.You will coordinate all activities within the Multifunctional Teams - Sub-MFT of your domain (with members from different functions like e.g. Engineering, Finance, PMO, Quality etc.) to safeguard the successful management of your sub-commodity, securing our lines and enabling value for money proposals for our platforms. With your work, you will contribute to the profitability of our company and to the expansion of our successful projects and related services, which is a vital part of Airbus Defence and Space growth strategy.Commodity management requires a strategic and robust plan to ensure that both value and risk are managed correctly, and innovation is encouraged. The role of a commodity manager is very complex and it has to be undertaken by someone who is capable of understanding markets, the supply chain and how the business works.Your tasks and responsibilities:- Establish, implement & monitor a Sub-Commodity strategy for your perimeter- Manage supplier relationships and supplier related development programs- Lead the (Sub-) Commodity Multi-Functional Teams- Lead, and drive to conclusion, bids, tenders and supplier selection processes- Lead and contribute to Procurement/ Value Creation projects & initiatives that aim at delivering synergies and savings- Lead negotiations with supplier to assure program expectations are meet- Set-up, negotiate and manage contractual agreements with suppliers, including negotiations for existing contracts and negotiation of new supplier contracts.- Lead Supplier Evaluation Development (SED) and define action plans to develop strategic suppliers.Desired skills and qualifications:- Degree in Engineering, Business Management or equivalent- A least 5 years of experience in activities which have allowed you to acquire sound skills and knowledge of:- Procurement- Engineering- Services- Project Management- Excellent negotiation skills and the ability to persuade, influence and convince- Experience of working in a matrix environment with proven record of successful stakeholder management- Able to anticipate, assess and mitigate risks- Excellent skills in relationship building, team building, empowering, motivating others and conflict management.- Negotiation level of English and German- Knowledge of SAP would be an assetThis position has a high visibility in Procurement and in the functions it is interfacing with (PMO, Services and Engineering).Not a 100% match? jobs.occupation: Master student (d/f/m)- Non-Destructive Testing Development for Additively Manufactured Ti-Al parts (Ingenieur/in - Werkstofftechnik)
jobs.description: About usAirbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.Job descriptionIn order to support our Engineering department, Airbus Helicopters is looking for aMaster student (d/f/m) in the field of Non-Destructive Testing Development for Additively Manufactured Ti-Al partsYou are looking for a master thesis and want to get to know the work of a job title? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Engineering department as a Master student (d/f/m) in the field of Non-Destructive Testing Development !- Location: Donauwörth- Start: As soon as possible- Duration: 3-6 monthsYour locationAt our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield.Your benefits- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 35-hour week (flexitime).- Mobile working after agreement with the department.- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.- Work with modern/diversified technologies.- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.Your tasks and responsibilities- Define the optimal measurement stages and witness-specimen concepts within the L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V process chain in an on-site additive manufacturing production.- Characterize measurement repeatability, geometry influences, and the natural resonance spectrum variation of nominally processed witness specimens across manufacturing stages.- Quantify the sensitivity of specific resonance modes and spectral features to controlled process- and material-state variations (e.g., microstructural changes, residual stress, defects, post-processing deviations).- Identify robust multivariate spectral features or frequency combinations and establish preliminary screening and acceptance criteria to reliably distinguish nominal from off-nominal material states.- Validate the screening concept against reference material state data and define a practical industrial implementation envelope, specifying how PCRT complements existing NDT and quality-assurance routes.- Desired Final Deliverable:An experimentally validated PCRT quality-screening methodology, utilizing a dedicated witness specimen tracked across key L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V manufacturing stages, that defines clear acceptance criteria and limits for catching abnormal material states before costly downstream processing.Desired skills and qualifications- You are an enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) seeking a master thesis in the field of mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, materials science, or non-destructive testing (or comparable fields).- Experience in additive manufacturing or 3D printing is beneficial.- You demonstrate a strong analytical mindset, solution-oriented thinking, independence, and a willingness to learn.- You are communicative, proficient in English, and have basic German skills.- You have the ability to work collaboratively in an international environment, liaising with development, production, industrialization, and quality assurance departments.- You are resilient and enjoy working in a dynamic and cutting-edge research topic.Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!#MYCYMThis job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growthBy submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.description: About Allianz Global InvestorsAllianz Global Investors is a leading active asset manager, managing assets for individuals, families, and institutions worldwide. Our shared goal to shape a future of opportunity for our clients is foundational to our culture and our values. We look to attract, and actively nurture, individuals with the drive to achieve excellence at every stage of the investment experience.We believe an inclusive culture is key to a flourishing workforce. Not only do we celebrate the broad range of experiences, backgrounds, and attributes that our workforce brings, but we support our people to live and work in a way that promotes their own wellbeing.Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer.  We are united by a shared commitment: to put our clients first and at the centre of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions.  Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future - for our clients and for the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. The foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and where integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust are at the heart of our culture.  We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations. If you feel inspired to promote the active asset management experience, this is the place for you. Join our international, technology-enabled, and agile environment. Simply upload your CV in English to apply for this position.  If you need support to navigate our websites or at any stage during your application, please send an email with your request to recruiting@allianzgi.com. To Recruitment Agencies:Allianz Global Investors has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz Global Investors does not accept unsolicited resumes from agency or search firm recruiters.When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. Fees will only be paid when there is a contract in place.Without a contract in place, we will not accept invoices on unsolicited resumes, even if the candidate was ultimately employed by Allianz Global Investors.Finally, please do not contact hiring managers directly.Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.How to Apply: Applying is quick and easy. Simply upload your CV, complete your personal details, confirm your consent for AI support in the "Additional Information" section, and submit your application.To support our recruiters, we use Fit Score—an AI‑powered tool that highlights how closely your profile aligns with the role. This helps us review applications more efficiently and focus on what matters most: your skills and experience.Good to know: The Fit Score is a support tool only. At Allianz, technology never replaces human judgment. Every application is carefully reviewed by our recruiting teams, ensuring a fair, thoughtful, and personal hiring process.109753 | Strategy | Professional | n.a. | Allianz Global Investors | Full-Time | PermanentWe are currently hiring a Personal Assistant (f/m/d) to provide high-level executive, administrative, and organisational support to the Chief Technology Officer, based in Munich.In this role, you will enable the effective operation of the DTO office by coordinating priorities, leadership forums, communications, travel, and engagement with senior stakeholders across Data, Technology & Operations, while providing administrative support to other members of the DTO leadership team as required.The role requires discretion, strong service mindset, great follow-through, and confidence working across functions, locations, cultures, and time zones.This position will be based in Munich.What you will do- Manage the CTO's complex diary, priorities, and meeting cadence.- Coordinate internal and external meetings, leadership forums, town halls, offsites, and other events.- Prepare agendas, briefing packs, presentations, minutes, action logs, and follow-up materials for executive engagements.- Arrange domestic and international travel, itineraries, visas where required, and expense submissions.- Act as a trusted gatekeeper for the DTO office, triaging requests and handling sensitive information with discretion.- Serve as a key liaison with DTO leadership, executive offices, external partners and visitors.- Provide administrative support to other members of the DTO leadership team as required, balancing these needs with the priorities of the CTO.- Support onboarding, access, procurement, invoice processing, distribution lists, and other administration for the DTO office.- Proactively identify, test, and embed responsible AI-enabled ways of working across DTO and other executive offices to simplify day-to-day tasks, improve quality and responsiveness.- Act as an AI (Artificial Intelligence) ambassador who encourages responsible adoption, shares practical use cases, and helps colleagues build confidence in AI-enabled ways of working.What you bring- Minimum five years' experience supporting C-suite or senior executives in a multinational organisation; experience in technology, financial services, or asset management is advantageous.- Proven experience coordinating complex diaries, international travel, executive meetings, and confidential matters.- Experience working across countries, cultures, seniority levels, and time zones.- University degree or Abitur (German university entrance qualification), or an equivalent secondary school-leaving qualification.- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365, particularly Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.- Excellent written communication, presentation preparation, organisation, and stakeholder-management skills.- Comfort with technology terminology and the ability to quickly understand executive priorities and organisational context.- Fluent written and spoken English; German is desirable.- Exceptional judgement, discretion, integrity, and professional maturity.- Proactive and able to anticipate needs, prioritise competing demands, and work independently with limited direction.- Calm, resilient, detail-oriented, and reliable under pressure, with strong follow-through.- Confident operating as an ambassador for the DTO office and building trusted relationships across functions and locations.- Flexible, collaborative, service-minded, and comfortable with ambiguity and evolving priorities.What we offer- We empower our employees by ensuring flexible work arrangements that maintain a balance between performance, productivity, career development and personal priorities (e.g., hybrid model/ flexible working hours)- Securing your future: Access to company pension/savings plans- Family support (relocation/ childcare facilities)- Company share purchasing plan- Mental health and wellbeing programs- Mobility solutions (Jobrad bike leasing, subvention Jobticket)- Career opportunities within the entire Allianz Group- Self-guided learning & development- Volunteering time- … and so much more!

jobs.occupation: Team Lead P&C Business Partners (f/m/d) (HR Business Partner)
jobs.employer_name: Josera Erbacher Service GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: For over 80 years, at ERBACHER the food family we have been developing innovative solutions in animal nutrition for livestock and pets, as well as producing high-quality food, made possible by the dedication of our teams in Germany, Ukraine, Tanzania, and Poland.Step by step, we turn ideas into innovations that have a real impact on everyday life, and every project is based on collaboration, mutual respect, and commitment. At ERBACHER the food family, we believe in a good tomorrow… and we create it.We are looking for people who want to create a good tomorrow together with us.Responsibilities- Lead and support the P&C Business Partners team through regular feedback and coaching.- Build trusted relationships with leaders, advise them on key people matters and connect them with P&C teams.- Help leaders turn business goals into clear people and team actions.- Manage conflicts and sensitive situations fairly and discreetly, involving Legal or other experts, when required.- Promote a culture based on trust, accountability and open communication.- Ensure effective management of employee and labour-related matters and ongoing process improvement.Requirements:- 3+ years’ HR/P&C Business Partner experience.- Degree in HR, business, law, psychology or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.- Good understanding of workforce planning, including skills, capacity, succession and hiring needs.- Solid knowledge of German employment law, HR processes and data protection.- Experience in collaboration with German works council.- Initial people-leadership or team-coordination experience.- Experience in cross-teams collaboration, including working with Talent Acquisition, People Operations, Development & Engagement, Legal and Corporate Communication teams.- Strong communication, coaching, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills.- C1/C2-level English and willingness to work from the office at least 3 days per week.What You Can ExpectPeople are at the heart of everything we do. We encourage individual talents and create an environment where everyone can contribute, bring ideas to life and work effectively as part of a team.What exactly can you expect from us?- Innovative, creative, and sometimes unconventional ways of thinking and working.- A wide range of development and training opportunities, as well as various language courses.- Flexible working arrangements and remote working.- A varied and challenging role with room to shape things, and the opportunity to have a say and put ideas into practice.- Flexible working hours – additional vacation days - Christmas and vacation bonuses.- Occupational pension scheme and accident insurance - bonus.- Sports, mobility, and health benefits.- Free muesli, fruit, and vegetables.- Healthy, subsidized lunches.- We support e-mobility with charging stations at our headquarters and the option to lease an electric vehicle.- Work - and enjoy team events together - in an international environment with colleagues from Poland, Germany, Tanzania, and Ukraine.- Ongoing professional and personal development through tailored training and development programs.- An inspiring, supportive atmosphere and modern working conditions, with tools and technologies that support your development and help you work more efficiently.*What matters is that we’re a good fit. Your background and gender are irrelevant.Does this sound like you? We look forward to receiving your detailed application, including your earliest possible start date and salary expectations. Please note that we can only consider applications submitted through the application form on our careers page.Contact detailsRecruiting TeamTel.: 09371 940-2220Email: jobs@food.family (jobs@food.family)  (for questions only)Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Organisationsentwicklung, Workflow-Management-SystemeErweiterte Kenntnisse: Personalplanung, Personalentwicklung, Talentmanagement, Arbeitsrecht, Datenschutz
